pages.title: God Is With You
pages.child_instruction: Color the child walking the autumn path toward the lit porch.
pages.bible_connection: The lit path is a picture that we do not have to be afraid, because God is with us.
pages.visual_prompt: Integrated black line-art coloring scene: a child walking an autumn woods path toward a warmly lit porch, tall trees, fallen leaves, a small handheld light. Do not depict God as a cartoon person. No letters in the artwork.

pages.title: Find the Courage Helpers
pages.child_instruction: Find and circle all 8 courage helpers. They can remind you that God is with you.
pages.bible_connection: Noticing helpers is practice for remembering Isaiah 41:10: do not be afraid, God is with you.
pages.visual_prompt: Controlled woods-path background without the eight targets. Independently placed hiking boot, walking stick, small lantern, map, compass, owl, blanket, and brave badge.

pages.title: Walk to the Lit Porch
pages.child_instruction: Start at the child on the path. Follow the woods trail to the lit porch.
pages.bible_connection: Walking all the way to the porch is a picture of taking a brave step because God is with you.
pages.visual_prompt: One autumn-woods scene: child at START on a leaf-strewn opening, unique tree-path maze, lit porch at FINISH. Not a maze pasted on a blank page.

pages.title: When I Feel Afraid
pages.child_instruction: Check what you can do when you feel afraid. Then draw a place you feel safe.
pages.bible_connection: These choices help a child practice Isaiah 41:10: do not fear, God is with you and will help you.
pages.visual_prompt: One porch-framed page: four illustrated choices, a large window drawing area, and a short prayer ribbon.

choices.label: Help a friend who is scared

pages.drawing_prompt: Draw a place you feel safe because God is with you
pages.prayer: God, when I feel afraid, help me remember You are with me.
